this trip was truly amazing. i met some of the most awesome fun people- and i never expected it. i feel like the 3 girls i met i've been friends with my whole life. we gave each other shit the whole time- not letting one thing slip. jenna is so sweet and fun (although two people asked if i was her mom, i still love her)! good thing i had her to drink with me every night! sarah is so kool aid! haha she's definitely full of life and will do anything for her friends. lynnette is the unexpected gal. wears a gucci fanny pack but used to fight forest fires. love the sarcasm too! i know i met friends that i will continue to talk to after this is over- we better because we have to all go mountain biking!! i call them my bitches as a term of endearment. :) i can't leave off andy. as the third person in our drinking group, we had too much fun and it wouldn't have been that great without him. he not only watched out for us but made sure we had a good time.
anyways, the trip was an incredible experience and i wouldn't trade it for anything.
